comparisons.name: home-light
comparisons.description: The whole Finder window, Aqua: the home folder in icon view with 160 pt icons, three tabs and the Shared Folder banner. Whole crop: every icon and glyph is a stand-in drawing and the text is set in the fallback font. The folder icons are plain stand-ins without Apple's emblems, and the three tabs are equally wide where the capture caught them at 372, 361 and 349 pt.

comparisons.name: home-light-layout
comparisons.description: As home-light with the stand-in artwork and the text masked (the title with its icon, the toolbar's glyphs from the view switcher to Tags, the search field's text, the folder icons with their names, the sidebar's rows), to score the frame, the title bar and toolbar, the bars, the sidebar's surface and divider and the placement of the view.

comparisons.name: get-info-light
comparisons.description: The whole Get Info window of "Aqua and Bondi.pdf", Aqua: title bar, header, tags field and the seven sections as the capture has them open and collapsed. Whole crop: the icons, the user glyphs and the lock are stand-in drawings, the text is set in the fallback font, the minimize and zoom buttons are disabled because the demo's Info window can only be closed, the list's header is the library's 23 pt one where Finder's small list has 17 pt, the privilege cells are plain text, and the library's gradient buttons are 21 pt high where Finder's small ones are 17 pt, without the action button.

comparisons.description: As get-info-light with the stand-in artwork and the text masked (the title with its icon, the header, the tags field's placeholder, the section titles, the labels and values of General and More Info, the checkbox titles, the name field's text, the pop-up button's title, the help text, the title of Change All, the permissions list, the buttons under it and the lock), to score the frame, the title bar and the window controls, the separators and the height of every section, the disclosure triangles, the field bezels, the checkbox boxes and the pop-up button's bezel.

comparisons.name: quick-look-bar-light
comparisons.description: The bar of the Quick Look panel, Aqua: the two discs, the title, Rotate Left, Markup, Open with Preview and Share. Only the bar is compared, the first 38 pt of the panel's material frame: under it the capture shows a desktop picture for which the demo has a gradient, and that picture is more than nine tenths of the panel, more than a comparison may mask. The panel's material is translucent, so the example paints behind the panel colours that give the bar the colours measured along it; the comparison scores the material's tint and the drawing on it, not the blur. Whole crop: the glyphs the demo draws (Markup and the Markup tools) are stand-in drawings, Rotate Left and Share are the library's system images, and the text is set in the fallback font.
